loops.minute_1: Place Dart Monkey or Ninja, generate cash from destroying first Bloon waves, observe basic enemy patterns (paired, regular spacing). Initial economy: cash collected from pops. First strategic choice: where to position tower for maximum track coverage.
loops.minute_10: Tower network expanding (2–3 towers active), acquisition of Monkey Money and Player XP drives meta-progression. Strategic depth emerges: positioning affects time towers engage track, tower spacing = coverage optimization. Transition: shift from survival to economy planning.
loops.hour_5: Progression in Hard difficulty (double cash reward). Discovery of Heroes (Obyn, Sauda, etc.) and Monkey Knowledge unlocks (6 upgrade trees). New enemy types introduced (Lead, Ceramic). Focus shifts to meta-progression: which hero pairs with tower strategy? Which MK node is mandatory for round 30+?
loops.endgame: Rounds 40+ (MOAB crunch point). Complex tower synergies required. Cross-pathing (combining three upgrade paths per tower) = emergent builds. Challenge: reach round 60+ or optimize for specific map/mode. Infinite progression structure (no natural victory condition).

objectives.defeat_condition: 1 Bloon leaks past the end of the track
objectives.player_goal: Maximize rounds reached; unlock meta strategies; collect Heroes and Monkey Knowledge; master cross-path synergies

games.retention_answer: Meta-progression depth (6 Monkey Knowledge trees, Hero XP up to level 20, Tower XP unlocks, account-level Monkey Money) + unsolved strategic challenges (Round 60 = research problem) + collection completionism (all Heroes, all tower synergies). Each run exposes a new strategic combination. The game is structured as a progression treadmill with no visible endpoint—players return to close gaps in their builds and to chase the next difficulty milestone.

loops.minute_1: Place Peashooter and Sunflower on first lane, generate sun (natural + collected), understand grid placement (5 lanes × 9 columns = parallel mini-games). First wave = basic Zombies. Feedback immediate: plant blocks or bullet hits. Economy: Sunflower early = sun acceleration strategy.
loops.minute_10: Plant counter-strategy emerges (Wall-nut vs Buckethead Zombie, Potatomine vs Poleycat). Feedback loop tight: failure reason transparent to player (wrong plant type, wrong lane, timing). New plant unlocked at level end. Zone-specific mechanics appear (Night = graves spawn, no natural sun).
loops.hour_5: Progression through 50 adventure levels × 5 zones. Zone transitions introduce new mechanics (Pool = aquatic plants, Fog = peashooter-only, Roof = space constraint). Constant plant unlock dopamine (1 per level ~). Side modes open: Puzzle Mode (Vasebreaker), Mini-games, Survival Mode.
loops.endgame: Survival Mode (infinite waves post-campaign). Mini-game challenges (Vasebreaker = destroy pots with limited plants). Daily Challenges (replayable, farmable). Collection of all 49 plants. Leaderboard via Survival score.

objectives.victory_condition: All zombie waves in a level destroyed before any zombie reaches the left edge (home)
objectives.defeat_condition: Any zombie crosses the leftmost tile (home invaded)
objectives.player_goal: Complete 50 levels, unlock all plant varieties, progress through 5 zones (Day, Night, Pool, Fog, Roof)
Maximize waves survived; compete on leaderboards; master plant economy

objectives.mode: Puzzle Mode (Vasebreaker, I Zombie, Last Stand)
objectives.victory_condition: Objective-specific (destroy all pots / survive as zombie / survive 30 waves)
objectives.player_goal: Complete puzzle constraints; unlock mini-game achievements

games.retention_answer: Constant plant unlocks (collection dopamine, 1 per level ~) + zone variety (each zone = new mechanics, new plants, visual progression) + accessible design (no spike, feedback transparent). PopCap sustains engagement via mode diversity (Adventure ≠ Puzzle ≠ Survival ≠ Daily Challenge) rather than mechanical depth alone. Players return to unlock the next plant, try a new zone, and replay via Daily Challenge.

loops.minute_1: Place Militia Barracks and Archer Tower, counter enemy types (Militia vs melee, Archer vs flying). Observe wave composition from in-game Encyclopedia. Economy: kills fund next tower placement. First strategic choice: which tower type counters this level's lead threat?
loops.minute_10: Tower synergy emerges (Militia HP tank + Archer DPS, Mage AoE vs clumps). Difficulty scaling: each level intro new enemy type → adapt strategy. Star system visible (0–3 per level). Heroes available (unlock per level). Upgrade path choice: which tower to boost first?
loops.hour_5: Completion of levels in Normal difficulty (1–2 stars per level). Then Heroic (1 star bonus, new strategy required). Then Iron (1 star bonus, extreme challenge). Total progression: 0/130 stars collected. Towers unlock as levels progress. Permanent skill tree grows. Meta-tower discovery (which tower is S-tier on this map?).
loops.endgame: Endless Mode: waves infinite, enemies scale +2% HP/DMG per wave, minibosses every 10 waves. Leaderboard competition (highest wave on Endless). Perfect completion (130/130 stars). Challenge variant mastery: prove competence on Heroic + Iron across all maps.

objectives.victory_condition: All enemy waves defeated before any enemy reaches map exit
objectives.defeat_condition: Player health reaches 0 (20 HP loss per leak)
objectives.player_goal: Clear level, earn 1–3 stars, unlock next level, progress toward campaign completion

objectives.victory_condition: All enemy waves defeated, higher difficulty setting
objectives.player_goal: Earn 1 bonus star per Heroic clear; prove mastery of map strategy

objectives.victory_condition: All enemy waves defeated, extreme difficulty
objectives.defeat_condition: Player fails to earn 1 bonus star per Iron clear
objectives.player_goal: Earn 1 bonus star per Iron clear; achieve 3/3 stars on all maps

objectives.defeat_condition: Any enemy reaches map exit; player health reaches 0
objectives.player_goal: Maximize waves survived; compete on global leaderboards; discover optimal tower composition

games.retention_answer: Star collection system (0/130 tangible completion goal) + tower unlock progression (each level = new tower type available) + difficulty variants (Normal/Heroic/Iron = 3 strategic approaches per map, emergent replayability) + Endless leaderboards (external social comparison) + permanent tower upgrades (account-level meta-progression). Players return to close star gaps, test new tower synergies, and chase leaderboard rankings. The 130-star cap provides a visible, achievable completion fantasy while Endless Mode offers infinite progression for players seeking no cap.
